title: How AI Changed the Way I Trade
author: Guilty-Effort-5200
selftext:
For the longest time, I thought successful trading meant spending hours staring at charts every day. Recently, I’ve been exploring AI-assisted trading, and it’s completely changed how I approach the markets.  
Instead of making emotional decisions, I let a data-driven system help identify potential trading opportunities while I stay in control of my account. It’s been an interesting way to learn and stay disciplined.  
I’m not saying it’s a magic solution trading always involves risk but it’s definitely made my routine much more structured.  
Is anyone else here using AI as part of their trading strategy? I’d love to hear your experience or answer any questions about how I use it.
